description: Live events on sale in one city on DICE (dice.fm), optionally filtered by category (e.g. "DJ", "Gigs", "Comedy", "Theatre"). Returns event name, status (on-sale/sold-out/etc), dates, venue, and starting price. Pass a city name or perm_name — it is resolved via dice_cities internally.

category.description: Optional category name or id to filter by, e.g. "DJ", "Comedy", "music:dj". Matched case-insensitively against DICE's own filter list.

city.description: City name or perm_name, e.g. "New York", "new_york", "London".

name: dice_browse
title: Dice Browse
